## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Overall and changed executable line coverage are both above 80%.
- [ ] Formatting, analyzers, and security scans pass.
- [ ] No credentials, local settings, or generated output are included.
- [ ] Any contract, configuration, or migration changes are documented.
- [ ] Each affected service's `COMMUNICATION.md` is updated, or has a specific review
      note explaining why communication is unchanged. Shared BuildingBlocks code or
      root Compose changes require reviewing every service diagram.
